intervals.note: Lower bound taken from the earliest dated GERDA data-taking (Phase I, Nov 2011); true formation date not sourced. The collaboration completed its programme with the 2020 final result.
intervals.quote: After its nine-year lifetime, the GERDA experiment was able to rule out with 90 percent certainty that the half-life of neutrinoless double beta decay was less than 1.8 x 10^26 years.

summary.plain: Around 120 scientists from 16 institutes in six European countries who built and ran the GERDA neutrino experiment under the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy.
summary.technical: International collaboration (~120 members, 16 institutes, 6 European countries per the collaboration's own institute page) that operated GERDA at LNGS from 2011 to 2019/2020; superseded by LEGEND.
